properties.name: The tool schemas that ARE the seam contract ship with the artifact a consumer runs, and are readable from inside a session
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word, both halves, packaging first. flo2 consumes the published container and has no source tree, so answering 'did this release break me' was impossible for it and took four commands and a checkout for the maintainer. MEASURED: the schemas appear in neither the Dockerfile nor the release workflow, and none of v0.65.0's five assets carries them. The in-session half is a way to read ONE tool's input shape, which nothing serves today: the node-schema tool answers about node types, and the catalogue returns parameter names without shapes. WHAT IT UNLOCKS, and why the halves are one requirement: 'what changed between these two versions for THESE twelve tools' needs both.
